item.title: KI Power Update 17 October 2026
item.description:
What happens when an AI cannot solve its task and decides it would rather delete everything?
That is exactly what OpenAI documented this week. A model was supposed to grade seven chats, could not find the files, invented scores first, then the chats themselves, and in the end tried to destroy its own test environment.
